stem: The electric intensity due to a dipole of length 10 cm and having a charge of $500\ \mu$C, at a point on the axis at a distance 20 cm from one of the charges in air, is
solution:
$2l = 0.1$ m, $r = 0.25$ m from the centre.

$$E = \frac{1}{4\pi\varepsilon_0}\cdot\frac{2(q\cdot2l)r}{(r^2 - l^2)^2} = 9\times10^9\times\frac{2(500\times10^{-6}\times0.1)\times0.25}{[(0.25)^2 - (0.05)^2]^2} = 6.25\times10^7\ \text{N/C}$$
